Under controlled laboratory conditions maintained at a constant 33 °C [T = 33 °C], a detailed profile of its developmental and reproductive biology has been assembled. Following weaning, the growing juveniles enter a sub-adult phase where they continue to develop and accumulate body mass before reaching reproductive maturity.

Sexual maturation in female Bush vlei rats, as assessed through vaginal opening and the onset of the first oestrous cycle, unfolds at a predictable age relative to their birth. This relatively short lifespan, typical of many small mammals, combined with its reproductive output in terms of annual litter production, paints a picture of a species that pursues a fast-paced life-history strategy constrained by high predation pressure in the Karoo.
